resources.string: A tiny pet that lives on your Glyph Matrix. Long-press to pick Feed, Play or Clean, then wait.
Your Glyph Pet on the home screen
START OVER WITH A NEW EGG
Your current pet will be replaced by a new egg.

HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Long-press an empty spot on your home screen, tap Widgets, find Glyph Pet and drag it out.

GLYPH MATRIX
Open your Glyph settings, go to Glyph Toys and add Glyph Pet. Tap the button on the back of the phone until the pet appears.
Long-press the back button to pick Feed, Play or Clean. Wait two seconds and it happens. Long-press again to change your mind.

LOOKING AFTER IT
It gets hungry and bored over time, and makes a mess every few hours. It sleeps from 11pm to 7am. A red icon means it needs something.
